messages:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout for release r2026.3. Feature flag 'search_v2' will be enabled in a sawtooth ramp: 0% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%. Change window 02:00-06:00 UTC. Target: search-service shards.

anna: Ok. We'll monitor p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, and ranking drift. Holdpoints at 10% and 30%.

mike: Can we pin the model to avoid late drift? request: model sha -> v2.1.3

anna: Pinning now in config:
```json
{"search_model_version":"v2.1.3","ff":"search_v2","ramp_policy":"sawtooth"}
```

olga-sre: Add SLO triggers: auto-rollback if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency +50ms vs baseline. Also set automated hold at 10% and 30% until ops ack.

jay: Canary commands queued. We'll start at 2% (eu-west1 + us-east1 cohorts).

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2% for cohorts eu-west1/us-east1. Telemetry: https://telemetry/redwood/deploys/6290001111 :rocket:

mike: Seeing small p95 uptick (~+10ms) but 5xx flat. Recommend hold at 2% for another 10m.

anna: Agree — hold. No further ramp until green on error budget.

olga-sre: Note: sticky sessions mean cache warming might spike latency on first requests. Enable prefix caching and warm keys if possible.

deploy-bot: Telemetry 10m snapshot: p95 +12ms, 5xx=0.08%. No automatic rollback triggered. Proceeding to 10% per plan.

jay: Advancing -> 10%. Updated traffic split for route /api/search -> variant=search_v2 for 10% cohorts.

anna: Reminder: emergency rollback target is v2.1.2 if we cross thresholds. Rollback command if needed:
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/search-service --to-revision=v2.1.2
```

mike: Watching logs and error traces :eyes:. Will shout if anything odd.

deploy-bot: Reached 30% at 04:12 UTC. Entering 30m soak. Final ramp to 100% scheduled after soak if no issues.

anna: If soak stable, final flush at ~05:00 UTC. Release notes (short): - improved ranking for long tail queries; - reduced tokenization regressions; - fixed crash on empty result.

olga-sre: Post-mortem checklist: check rate of 5xx, tail latency, cache-evictions. If rollback happens, document time and cohort percentages.

jay: All set from infra side. I'll update the release ticket and annotate the ff toggle steps. :thumbsup:
